references.title: Comet Tails Observed from Dark-Sky Reserves in the Northern Hemisphere
references.abstract: BACKGROUND: Comet tails are faint and easily lost to skyglow. METHODS: Observers at twelve reserves photographed three comets on the same nights. RESULTS: Tails were traced twice as far from the darkest reserves.

references.title: Sky brightness before and after the conversion of a city's streetlights to LEDs (SKYGLOW): a multicentre, before-after, controlled survey
references.abstract: BACKGROUND: Many cities have replaced sodium streetlights with LEDs. METHODS: Sky brightness was measured at forty sites before and after conversion, with twenty sites in an unconverted city as controls.

references.title: Sky brightness before and after the conversion of a city's streetlights to LEDs (SKYGLOW): five-year follow-up and spectral analysis of a before-after, controlled survey
references.abstract: BACKGROUND: We report five further years of measurements from the SKYGLOW survey. METHODS: The forty sites were measured each winter.

references.title: Meteor Counts Under Amber Versus White Streetlights As a First Test of Spectral Tuning: The AMBER Survey
references.abstract: PURPOSE: To compare meteor counts under amber and white streetlights. METHODS: Observers counted Perseids from paired sites.

references.title: Variable Stars Observed Through Urban Skyglow, Alone or in Combination with Narrowband Filters
references.abstract: PURPOSE: To report how many variable stars urban observers could follow with and without narrowband filters.
